title: 1999 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: The drummer gets sick. The concert is cancelled. Walter and Gretel must make enough pans of cookies to supply \(216\) cookies. There are \(8\) tablespoons in a stick of butter. How many sticks of butter will be needed? (Some butter may be left over, of course.)

solutions.text:
To make \(216\) cookies, they have to make \[ \left\lceil \dfrac{216}{15} \right\rceil = 15 \] pans. Since each pan requires \(3\) tablespoons of butter, all the pans will need \(15 \cdot 3 = 45\) tablespoons.

They will then need \[ \left\lceil \dfrac{45}{8} \right\rceil = 6 \] sticks of butter.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: First round the number of pans up
Convert tablespoons of butter to sticks and round up
